verdict.rationale: Figma provides multiple first-party mechanisms mapping design to code: Code Connect (maps design components to real codebase components, verified live via CLI probe), and the MCP server which generates code from selected frames and extracts variables/components/layout into an IDE, with the MCP endpoint confirmed live in probes. However, community hands-on feedback indicates the raw generated output (e.g., CSS with absolute positioning, manual SVG re-export) often isn't directly shippable without cleanup, showing a gap between docs claims and dev experience. Missing for 10: independent verification that MCP/Code Connect output is production-ready without manual rework, and broader real-world case studies beyond the vendor's own docs.
